overview.Name: Mama's Creations, Inc.
overview.Description: Mama's Creations, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets fresh deli-prepared foods in the United States. The company offers chicken, beef and turkey meatballs, meat loaf, sausage-related products, and pasta and rice entrees; olives, olive mixes, and savory products; and hot bars, salad bars, prepared foods, sandwich, and cold deli and foods-to-go sections. It sells its products directly to supermarkets, club chains, mass-market retailers; and food retailer and distributors, as well as through website and social media channels. The company was formerly known as MamaMancini's Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Mama's Creations, Inc. in August 2023. Mama's Creations, Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in East Rutherford, New Jersey.
